title: Prerequisite Pathboard
user: Adults relearning a technical subject who need to expose missing prerequisites and choose the next small concept deliberately.
smallest_useful_product: Offline graph board with goal nodes, prerequisite edges, a can explain/can solve/not yet status, and one next-session recommendation derived only from user-entered dependencies.
constraints: All graph data exportable as JSON/Markdown; avoid claims of pedagogical diagnosis; accessible non-graph list view required.
summary: Map prerequisites backward and choose the next concept to repair.
